title: tylophora silvestrii
intro: Tylophora silvestrii, commonly known as 'Wild ipecacuanha', is a plant species belonging to the Asclepiadaceae family. It is native to tropical regions, particularly in India and Southeast Asia. The health benefits of Tylophora silvestrii include its potential in treating fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, while its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and bronchodilatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Tylophora silvestrii include alkaloids, such as tylophorine and tylophorinidine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
